basis: The full-period district heat demand change from 2005 to 2015 is calculated as the difference between the 2005 endpoint value (24.0°C) and the 2015 endpoint value (10.0°C), yielding a 14.0°C absolute change. The chart and task materials do not provide an explicit numeric threshold or stated criterion for what constitutes a 'substantial-change' that requires follow-up. The routing criterion is defined as 'whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up'.
option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
